item.title: TIRED OF WAITING: Women composers are making the changes they want to see
item.description: Chen Yi When it comes to equal rights for women in the workplace, classical music has made considerable strides during the past half-century. Many American conservatories now boast from 40 to 50 percent female enrollment, and in other countries those numbers are even higher. A natural result of this, perhaps, is that symphony orchestras, once an almost all-male bastion, are now fast approaching gender equality. item.description: It is not just because they are women that you should pay attention to these composers.
